column1: # Canonical Infocom titles, keyed by IFDB tuid (the id in ifdb.org/viewgame?id=...).
# Format: <tuid><TAB><Title>. Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are
# ignored. Titles are spelled exactly as known_titles.tsv spells them, so the
# same title-to-hint-key logic applies. This is the fallback identity for a
# story whose IFID known_titles.tsv does not name (a build compiled from the
# public ZIL source, a beta release): a story linked to the game's IFDB page
# carries that tuid, and the tuid asserts which game it is.
# Provenance: every tuid below was checked against ifdb.org on 2026-10-05
# (search by title, then the game's own page for its title and author).
# Zork I Demo, Mini-Zork and the samplers are deliberately absent.
